title: Front of Eye Full Animation narration
timingSource: Single media timeline: visual holds are encoded into New_FrontofEyeFullAnim_timed.mp4 by scripts/build-front-of-eye-timed-video.cjs. Original-video holds: 6s/4s, 16s/5.5s, 40.5s/5s, 72.5s/7s, 77s/4s, 83.5s/4s, 87.5s/3.1s, 103.4s/7.5s, 113.9s/1.1s, 121s/3s. Captions, narration and seek bar all use this timed video's clock.

en.label: English
en.style: Calm, clear adult medical educator; slightly slow; neutral rather than promotional

cues.screenText: Observe the periorbital area, eyelids and eyes
cues.en: Observe the periorbital area, eyelids and eyes, noting any abnormalities.
cues.notes: Begins when the general observation sequence appears.

cues.en: Then perform a magnified examination. Prepare the Arclight by selecting the brightest light setting.

ttsText.en: Then perform a magnified examination. Prepare the Arc-light by selecting the brightest light setting.

cues.notes: Timed to preparation of the Arclight and magnifying loupe.

cues.screenText: Approach the right eye until focused
cues.en: Hold the device close to your eye. Slowly approach the patient's right eye first until it is in focus.
cues.notes: Source video 16s holds from media time 20–25.5s; this narration ends at 24.5s.

cues.en: Ask the patient to look right, then left.
cues.notes: Starts at playback time 27s without an additional visual hold.

cues.screenText: Look up and down and group the structures
cues.en: Then ask them to look up and down while gently holding their eyelids. Note the different structures seen, thinking of them in groups.
cues.notes: Starts at playback time 38s and finishes before the first structure group.

cues.en: The first group includes the upper and lower eyelashes and lid margins.
cues.notes: Source video 40.5s: encoded hold at playback time 50–55s while this sentence plays and clears.

cues.en: The second includes the conjunctiva and sclera,
cues.notes: Continues into the lower-fornix cue.

cues.en: including the lower fornix.
cues.notes: Corrects the supplied term 'forenax' to the anatomical term 'fornix'.

cues.en: The third group is the cornea,
cues.notes: Begins the third highlighted structure group.

cues.en: and its junction with the sclera, called the limbus,
cues.notes: Corrects the supplied term 'limbis' to 'limbus'.

cues.en: as well as the pupil, which is surrounded by the iris.
cues.notes: Completes the grouped anterior-eye anatomy.

cues.en: These are pictures of different conditions. Take time to examine with your Arclight.

ttsText.en: These are pictures of different conditions. Take time to examine with your Arc-light.

cues.notes: Source 72.5s is held at playback 87–94s until narration and captions finish.

cues.en: The anterior chamber is the space between the cornea and the iris.
cues.notes: Follows the conditions cue without overlapping narration.

cues.en: By shining the light from the temporal side, the depth of the anterior chamber can be assessed.
cues.notes: Finishes during the encoded temporal-light frame hold at playback time 109–113s (source 83.5s).

cues.en: A nasal shadow can suggest a shallow chamber. Refer.
cues.notes: Source 87.5s holds at playback 117–120.1s until the nasal-shadow narration finishes.

cues.en: Use a fluorescein strip or a Minims dropper to apply fluorescein to the eye.
cues.notes: Starts at playback 124s; existing 5.59s narration finishes before blue-light inspection.

cues.en: Select the blue light and inspect the cornea.
cues.notes: Corresponds to video time 98 seconds after 32.6 seconds of accumulated holds.

cues.en: Areas of epithelial loss and disease will be highlighted. Record the site and size of these areas.
cues.notes: Source 103.4s shows stained corneal examples; held at playback 136–143.5s until narration and captions finish.

cues.en: Gently pinch and hold the eyelashes of the upper lid with your thumb and index finger.
cues.notes: Starts at playback time 151s; source 113.9s holds at 154–155.1s, allowing this 5.66-second sentence to finish before the cotton-bud narration.

cues.screenText: Evert the upper lid over a cotton bud
cues.en: Place a cotton bud on the upper eyelid, use it as a fulcrum and turn the lid upwards.
cues.notes: Begins early enough to remain active at the requested 116.5-second video action.

cues.screenText: Inspect first with the naked eye
cues.en: Hold the lid everted and inspect its inner surface, first with the naked eye,
cues.notes: The video holds at 121 seconds for three seconds while narration and captions continue.

cues.en: then bring in the Arclight for a magnified view.

ttsText.en: Then bring in the Arc-light for a magnified view.

cues.notes: Corresponds closely to video time 124 seconds after the accumulated 44.2 seconds of holds.
